Further, it may be noted that as per doctrine of precedent, in nutshell, the earliest / oldest judgment, of the largest bench, of the highest court has to be followed.

For example, the ratio of judgment delivered by three judges bench of Hon'ble Supreme Court on the same facts is binding on Hon'ble two judges bench of Hon'ble Supreme Court itself as well as on all strength judgments of all the Hon'ble High Courts and all the trial courts.

In fact, such judgment of three judges bench of Hon'ble Supreme Court would also be binding on subsequent Hon'ble Three Judges bench of Hon'ble Supreme Court, as also held in the Pranay Sethi (supra) above.

It may further be noted that any subsequent judgment of same or lower number of Hon'ble Judges, contrary to such three judges bench Hon'ble Supreme Court judgment is to be held as "per incuriam".
